statement: 精确一阶固有频率 omega_1 = sqrt(g k tanh(k h)) = 0.9262 rad/s（k = pi/L，kh = 0.6283）；L/40 受迫算例（A = 0.25 m，6 个周期）壁压时历谱峰 0.9243 rad/s（源记录，FFT 首极大 + 抛物线细化），相对精确色散 0.9980（偏差 0.20%）。本包以细网格直接求极大独立复算得 0.9229 rad/s，比值 0.9964：两个估计器相差 0.16%，因为该谱峰在 0.90-0.94 rad/s 区间极其平坦（谱幅值起伏 < 0.4%）。两种估计均远在 3% 以内，故自由面 LBM 的一阶频率标定通过，但受迫信号谱峰只支撑到约 0.2% 的频率结论粒度。

scope.system: forced standing wave in a rectangular tank, wall-pressure history
conditions: excitation a(t) = A omega^2 sin(omega t) at omega = omega_1, A = 0.25 m
wall-pressure panel averaged over the lower half depth of the impacted wall
exclusions: single grid (L/40); no grid-refinement of the frequency estimate

notes: estimator-class difference documented rather than hidden: the source uses the first FFT bin maximum plus parabolic refinement, this package a two-stage direct scan
the sampling interval is slightly non-uniform (t[1]-t[0] = 0.0159665 s vs mean 0.0159615 s), a further 0.03% on the frequency axis
